רעג.ja: מן צ'רוב אלפצ'איל ואלפראיץ' ירום תרויעך ותעט'ים אלאמר פי נפסך לתכסל ענך.
רעג.en: So too in every kind among the kinds of excellences and obligations, he aims to frighten you and make the matter great in your soul that you may be lazy.

pairs.en: in every kind among the kinds of excellences and obligations
he aims to frighten you
and make the matter great in your soul
that you may be lazy

רעג.ja: ואד'א אשרפת עלי עמל מעציה חבב אליך לד'תהא ואנסאך עאקבתהא, ונשטך אלי עמלהא ואלמיל אליהא.
רעג.en: When you are about to do an act of disobedience, he makes its pleasure beloved to you and makes you forget its outcome; he makes you eager to do it and to incline toward it.

pairs.en: When you are about to do an act of disobedience
he makes its pleasure beloved to you
and makes you forget its outcome
he makes you eager to do it and to incline toward it

רעג.ja: פאד'א פטנת למת'ל ד'לך מנה, פרד עליה באן כל אלם ג'אז עליך פימא תקדם מן עמרך לם יבק מנה את'ר פיך בל ד'הב סריעא ודת'ר ושיכא, ואן אג'רה באק לך ללדהר לא ינקצ'י ולא יפני, באן אלצאים אד'א צאם ת'ם אפטר באלליל כאנה מא צאם ועאד אלי קוותה ובקי אג'רה מחפוט'א, כד'לך אלסאהר בעץ' לילה אד'א נאם עאד אלי נשאטה וכאנה מא סהר ובקי לה ת'ואב קיאמה ופצ'ל צלאתה ללדהר,
רעג.en: When you are sharp to the like of this from him, respond to him that every pain that has passed over you in what has gone before of your life has left no trace in you; rather it has gone quickly and waned swiftly. The reward for it remains for you forever, never ending. For one who fasts and then breaks his fast at night, it is as though he had not fasted; he returns to his strength, and the reward of his fast remains preserved. So too the one who keeps watch part of the night — when he sleeps he returns to his alertness, as though he had not been awake; and the reward of his standing and the bounty of his prayer remain for him forever.

pairs.en: When you are sharp to the like of this from him
respond to him
every pain that has passed over you
rather it has gone quickly and waned swiftly

pairs.ja: ואן אג'רה באק לך ללדהר לא ינקצ'י ולא יפני
pairs.en: The reward for it remains for you forever, never ending

pairs.ja: באן אלצאים אד'א צאם ת'ם אפטר באלליל
pairs.en: For one who fasts and then breaks his fast at night

pairs.ja: כאנה מא צאם ועאד אלי קוותה
pairs.en: it is as though he had not fasted; he returns to his strength
and the reward of his fast remains preserved
So too the one who keeps watch part of the night

pairs.ja: אד'א נאם עאד אלי נשאטה וכאנה מא סהר
pairs.en: when he sleeps he returns to his alertness, as though he had not been awake

pairs.ja: ובקי לה ת'ואב קיאמה ופצ'ל צלאתה ללדהר
pairs.en: and the reward of his standing and the bounty of his prayer remain for him forever

רעג.ja: ואמא אמר אלזכאה פקד ביינתה פי באב אלתוכל ביאנא כאפיא.
רעג.en: As for the matter of the zakāh, I have explicated it in the Gate of Reliance with sufficient explanation.

pairs.en: As for the matter of the zakāh

pairs.ja: פקד ביינתה פי באב אלתוכל ביאנא כאפיא
pairs.en: I have explicated it in the Gate of Reliance with sufficient explanation

רעג.ja: ואמא אמר אלמעאצי פרדד פי נפסך ואכ'טר עלי באלך ד'האב לד'אתך סריעא חלאלהא וחראמהא, ובקא עאר מא קבח מנהא עליך ועקאבהא פי אלדניא ואלאכ'רה לך.
רעג.en: As for the matter of the acts of disobedience: repeat in your soul, summon to your mind the swift departure of their pleasure — what is permitted of them and what is forbidden — and the remaining of the disgrace of what is ugly among them upon you, and their punishment in this world and the next.

pairs.en: As for the matter of the acts of disobedience
repeat in your soul

pairs.ja: ואכ'טר עלי באלך ד'האב לד'אתך סריעא
pairs.en: summon to your mind the swift departure of their pleasure
what is permitted of them and what is forbidden

pairs.ja: ובקא עאר מא קבח מנהא עליך
pairs.en: and the remaining of the disgrace of what is ugly among them upon you
and their punishment in this world and the next

רעג.ja: פענד ד'לך ינהזם אלהוי בין ידיך, ותנשט ללעמל אלצאלח, ותכסל ען כל עמל קביח.
רעג.en: At this, caprice is routed before you, and you are alert to good work and lazy concerning every ugly work.

pairs.ja: פענד ד'לך ינהזם אלהוי בין ידיך

רעג.ja: פאד'א קטע רג'אה ענך מן הד'א אלוג'ה ואמצ'ית עזמך ועמלת שיא מן אלטאעאת, ראם אדכ'אל אלהמום פי קלבך ותואתר אלגמום עליך ליקע מנך אלנדם עלי מא תקדם לך מן אלעמל אלצאלח, ליחרמך אלת'ואב עליה וקבול אללה לה מנך.
רעג.en: If he despairs of you in this aspect, and you have set your resolve and have done some of the obediences, he aims to introduce griefs into your heart and the succession of sorrows upon you, that regret may fall upon you for what has come before of good work — that he may deprive you of the reward upon it and of God's acceptance of it from you.

pairs.ja: פאד'א קטע רג'אה ענך מן הד'א אלוג'ה
pairs.en: If he despairs of you in this aspect
and you have set your resolve
and have done some of the obediences
he aims to introduce griefs into your heart
and the succession of sorrows upon you
that regret may fall upon you

pairs.ja: עלי מא תקדם לך מן אלעמל אלצאלח
pairs.en: for what has come before of good work

pairs.ja: ליחרמך אלת'ואב עליה וקבול אללה לה מנך
pairs.en: that he may deprive you of the reward upon it and of God's acceptance of it from you

רעג.ja: ואן אתית שיא מן אלמעאצי ראם אדכ'אל אלסרור פי קלבך ואלפרח במא תקדם לך לתקוי בצירתך בד'לך ותנשט אליה.
רעג.en: If you have done something of the acts of disobedience, he aims to introduce joy into your heart and gladness in what has come before to you — that he may strengthen your judgment by that and make you eager toward it.

pairs.en: If you have done something of the acts of disobedience
he aims to introduce joy into your heart
and gladness in what has come before to you
that he may strengthen your judgment by that and make you eager toward it

רעג.ja: פאן פטנת למכאידה ושערת לצ'רוב מצאידה כנת עלי חד'ר מנהא, ואסתענת באללה עלי אלתכ'לץ מנהא.
רעג.en: If you are sharp to his stratagem and aware of his various snares, you are on guard from them; you take help from God in delivering yourself from them.

pairs.en: If you are sharp to his stratagem
and aware of his various snares
you are on guard from them
you take help from God in delivering yourself from them

רעג.ja: ואן לם תשער להא אצרעך בגתה ואפרג סהאמה פיך גפלה, כמא קאל עד יפלח חץ כבדו כמהר צפור אל פח ולא ידע כי בנפשו הוא.
רעג.en: If you are not aware of them, he throws you down suddenly and unloads his arrows upon you in heedlessness, as Scripture said: "Until an arrow split his liver, like the bird hastening to the snare, and he did not know that it was for his soul" (Proverbs 7:23).

pairs.en: If you are not aware of them
